title: Proof collaboration-server proposed application and transport contracts
description: Strict decision-candidate contracts for operations without an accepted localized-content v2 input/result Schema, plus closed persisted operation-effect preimages needed to bind localized successes in the collaboration registry.

httpsIssuerUri.description: An absolute HTTPS OIDC issuer identifier with no query or fragment. A path is permitted and exact byte-for-byte issuer comparison is required.

localizedChangeSetCreateOperationEffectV.description: Exact persisted P5 changeset.create/v2 application-effect preimage. The digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785 of this whole closed value.
localizedChangeSetCreateOperationEffectV.x-proof-effect-reconstruction: request_digest is the exact persisted digest of the accepted ChangeSetCreateInput request projection. result is projected from the exact ChangeSetCreateOutput byte-for-byte: all seven output fields are copied and no field is omitted, added or renamed.

localizedChangeSetAddOperationEffectV1.description: Exact persisted P5 changeset.add/v2 application-effect preimage. The digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785 of this whole closed value.
localizedChangeSetAddOperationEffectV1.x-proof-effect-reconstruction: request_digest is the exact persisted digest of the accepted ChangeSetAddInput request projection. result is the exact ChangeSetAddOutput byte-for-byte; edit_ids is the assigned input-order list, first_ordinal is its first persisted ordinal and total_edit_count is the resulting complete count.

localizedContextBuildOperationEffectRequ.description: Exact normalized request preimage whose proof:operation-effect:v1 digest is embedded in localizedContextBuildOperationEffectV1. policy_rules are replaced by the digest of their exact accepted normalized policy manifest; no other ContextBuildInput field is changed or omitted.
localizedContextBuildOperationEffectRequ.x-proof-policy-projection-rule: Normalize ContextBuildInput.policy_rules by sorting each disallowed_values array by UTF-8 bytes, sorting rules by (locale,pointer), and rejecting duplicates; policy_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:policy-bundle:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/localized-content-policy/v1,rules:<that exact normalized array>}.

localizedContextBuildOperationEffectV1.description: Exact persisted P5 context.build/v2 application-effect preimage. The digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785 of this whole closed value.
localizedContextBuildOperationEffectV1.x-proof-effect-reconstruction: request_digest is the persisted proof:operation-effect:v1 digest of the accepted canonical context request projection, including policy_digest rather than policy_rules. result.context_pack_id and result.context_pack_digest equal the same-named ContextBuildOutput fields byte-for-byte; the larger manifest and resource-intent projection are deliberately not part of this effect preimage.

localizedChangeSetSubmitOperationEffectV.description: Exact persisted P5 changeset.submit/v2 application-effect preimage. Unlike the other keyed localized mutations this derived-key lifecycle effect contains no request_digest. The digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785 of this whole closed value.
localizedChangeSetSubmitOperationEffectV.x-proof-effect-reconstruction: result.changeset_id, sealed_changeset_digest and validation_results_digest equal ChangeSetSubmitOutput; occurred_at equals output.submitted_at; principal_id is the authenticated requesting Principal that owns the ChangeSet; approval is exactly null. Output status is not part of this effect preimage.

localizedChangeSetCommitOperationEffectV.description: Exact persisted P5 changeset.commit/v2 application-effect preimage. The digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785 of this whole closed value.
localizedChangeSetCommitOperationEffectV.x-proof-effect-reconstruction: request_digest is the exact persisted digest of the accepted ChangeSetCommitInput request projection. The result fields equal ChangeSetCommitOutput except status is omitted and each rendition is the exact closed projection {digest:rendition_digest,edit_id,locale,object_id,revision}; array length/order equals the complete effective-edit order and is 1..=100.

localizedEditionCreateOperationEffectV1.description: Exact persisted P5 edition.create/v2 application-effect preimage. The digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785 of this whole closed value.
localizedEditionCreateOperationEffectV1.x-proof-effect-reconstruction: request_digest is the exact persisted digest of the accepted EditionCreateInput request projection. result.edition_digest, edition_id and state equal EditionCreateOutput byte-for-byte; result.changeset_id equals normalized input.changeset_id and the immutable Edition manifest's changeset_id. The output manifest itself is not part of this effect preimage.

agentBindingIssueInputV1.description: Exact authenticated-Human input for one accepted Ed25519 Agent binding. Caller fields are copied without reinterpretation; identity, authority and issue-time fields are server-derived from proven enrollment and the locked authority head.
agentBindingIssueInputV1.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For agent-binding.issue/v1 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {audience,binding_id,principal_id,public_key,enrollment_challenge_digest,enrollment_envelope_digest,not_before,expires_at,supersedes_binding_id,idempotency_key} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:agent-binding.issue,version:proof.dev/operation/agent-binding.issue/v1}}; private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
agentBindingIssueInputV1.x-proof-success-cross-check: Result binding_id, principal_id, public_key, audience, enrollment_challenge_digest, enrollment_envelope_digest, not_before, expires_at and supersedes_binding_id equal input byte-for-byte. Result workspace_id equals the authenticated command Workspace and audience is exactly proof://workspace/{workspace_id}. principal_type, algorithm and key_usage are agent, ed25519 and authenticated-command. authenticated_subject is the exact proof/local-ed25519 subject proven by the pinned enrollment challenge/envelope and same public key. issued_by_principal_id is the authenticated requesting Human; issued_at is generated once and retry-stable. Result authority_sequence == locked evaluated authority-head sequence + 1 without overflow and previous_authority_record_digest equals that head's record digest.
agentBindingIssueInputV1.x-proof-success-binding: For operation agent-binding.issue/v1, the success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is required-uuidv7 and application_key equals input.idempotency_key; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact PrincipalBindingV1 result); application_effect_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:remote-authority-record:v1 over RFC 8785(that exact decoded authority payload); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

agentBindingRevokeInputV1.description: Exact Human operation input for revoking an accepted Ed25519 Agent principal binding. Rotation is an Agent-key lifecycle reason and is deliberately absent from the OIDC binding reason vocabulary.
agentBindingRevokeInputV1.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For agent-binding.revoke/v1 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {binding_id,reason,idempotency_key} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:agent-binding.revoke,version:proof.dev/operation/agent-binding.revoke/v1}}; private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
agentBindingRevokeInputV1.x-proof-success-cross-check: The server locks one active PrincipalBindingV1 whose binding_id equals input.binding_id. Result binding_id and reason equal input byte-for-byte; workspace_id equals the authenticated command Workspace; revoked_by_principal_id is the authenticated requesting Human; revocation_id and revoked_at are generated once and retry-stable. Result authority_sequence == locked evaluated authority-head sequence + 1 without overflow and previous_authority_record_digest equals that head's record digest. The operation appends a revocation and never edits the binding.
agentBindingRevokeInputV1.x-proof-success-binding: For operation agent-binding.revoke/v1, the success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is required-uuidv7 and application_key equals input.idempotency_key; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact PrincipalBindingRevocationV1 result); application_effect_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:remote-authority-record:v1 over RFC 8785(that exact decoded authority payload); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

oidcBindingRevokeInputV1.description: Exact Human operation input for revoking one commitment-only OIDC subject binding. OIDC bindings cannot use the Agent-only rotation reason.
oidcBindingRevokeInputV1.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For oidc-binding.revoke/v1 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {binding_id,reason,idempotency_key} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:oidc-binding.revoke,version:proof.dev/operation/oidc-binding.revoke/v1}}; protected OIDC identity/opening bytes, private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
oidcBindingRevokeInputV1.x-proof-success-cross-check: The server locks one active protected/public OIDC binding pair whose binding_id equals input.binding_id. Result binding_id and reason equal input byte-for-byte; binding_record_digest is the proof:remote-authority-record:v1 digest of the exact prior public OidcPrincipalBindingV1; principal_id and subject_commitment equal that binding; workspace_id equals the authenticated command Workspace; revoked_by_principal_id equals the authenticated requesting Human and revoked_by_actor_context_digest equals that command's public actor-context-evidence digest; revocation_id and revoked_at are generated once and retry-stable. Result evaluated_authority_head equals the exact locked authorization-decision head, authority_sequence == evaluated_authority_head.sequence + 1 without overflow, previous_authority_record_digest == evaluated_authority_head.record_digest and authority_key_id is the selected Workspace authority key. Protected lookup/opening bytes remain protected and unchanged.
oidcBindingRevokeInputV1.x-proof-success-binding: For operation oidc-binding.revoke/v1, the success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is required-uuidv7 and application_key equals input.idempotency_key; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact OidcPrincipalBindingRevocationV1 result); application_effect_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:remote-authority-record:v1 over RFC 8785(that exact decoded authority payload); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

contentResourceIntentIssueInputV1.description: Exact authenticated-Human request for one immutable ContentResourceIntentV1. Targets are caller-selected, nonempty and already canonical; the server pins the complete current released baseline rather than accepting a caller-supplied baseline.
contentResourceIntentIssueInputV1.x-proof-set-order: targets are strictly sorted by (object_id, schema_id, locale) ascending canonical UTF-8 bytes with no duplicate tuple; the server rejects rather than silently reorders caller bytes
contentResourceIntentIssueInputV1.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For content-resource-intent.issue/v1 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {intent_id,environment_id,targets,idempotency_key,issued_at} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:content-resource-intent.issue,version:proof.dev/operation/content-resource-intent.issue/v1}}; private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
contentResourceIntentIssueInputV1.x-proof-success-cross-check: Result intent_id, environment_id, targets and issued_at equal input byte-for-byte; workspace_id and issued_by_principal_id equal the authenticated command Workspace and requesting Human. Result base is the exact current versioned Release/Edition/KnownState closure for input.environment_id locked at issuance; every target Object exists in that Edition and its actual Schema equals target.schema_id. The immutable content-intent bytes exclude the external intent digest. Input idempotency_key binds replay evidence but is not injected into the result artifact.
contentResourceIntentIssueInputV1.x-proof-success-binding: For operation content-resource-intent.issue/v1, the success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is required-uuidv7 and application_key equals input.idempotency_key; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact ContentResourceIntentV1 result); application_effect_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:content-resource-intent:v1 over RFC 8785(that exact result artifact); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

changeSetApproveInputV3.description: Exact approval selector closure. Every expected_* digest is a caller-pinned immutable value; the server loads that exact value at expected_authority_head and rejects substitution instead of silently following a newer head.
changeSetApproveInputV3.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For changeset.approve/v3 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {approval_id,approval_name,changeset_id,expected_sealed_changeset_digest,expected_proposal_digest,expected_validation_results_digest,expected_submission_digest,expected_resource_intent_digest,expected_context_pack_digest,expected_environment_config_digest,expected_policy_bundle_digest,expected_validation_policy_digest,expected_authority_head,idempotency_key} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:changeset.approve,version:proof.dev/operation/changeset.approve/v3}}; private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
changeSetApproveInputV3.x-proof-approval-cross-check: The authenticated Human command Workspace equals result.workspace_id. Its current OIDC Principal, subject commitment, binding and public actor-context-evidence digest equal result.approver_principal_id, approver_subject_commitment, approver_binding_id and approver_actor_context_digest; reviewer_role_assignment_digest names that approver's exact active content.reviewer assignment at input.expected_authority_head. Result approval_id, approval_name, changeset_id and idempotency_key equal input byte-for-byte, approval_decision is approved, approved_at is retry-stabilized committed server time, and normalized_input_digest is the proof:remote-normalized-operation-input:v1 digest declared here. Each input expected_sealed_changeset_digest, expected_proposal_digest, expected_validation_results_digest, expected_submission_digest, expected_resource_intent_digest, expected_context_pack_digest, expected_environment_config_digest, expected_policy_bundle_digest and expected_validation_policy_digest equals the correspondingly named ChangeSetApprovalV1 digest byte-for-byte. The loaded sealed ChangeSet, proposal and effective leaves, validation result, submission, resource intent, ContextPack, active EnvironmentConfig, policy bundle and validation policy reproduce every result identity/version/digest, including requesting_principal_id, requesting_subject_commitment, submission_id, resource_intent_id, context_pack_id, environment_id, environment_config_version, environment_activated_by_principal_id and effective_leaves_digest. Result operating_principal_id equals the operating Agent in the accepted release.create trace; result.publisher_principal_id equals result.operating_principal_id exactly and equals that same trace Principal. Approver/requester/operating-publisher/environment-activator separation-of-duty inequalities still apply. Result evaluated_authority_head equals input.expected_authority_head; authority_sequence is exactly head.sequence + 1 without overflow, previous_authority_record_digest equals head.record_digest and authority_key_id is the selected Workspace authority key. No current-head, actor, publisher, closure, policy-selector or digest substitution is permitted.
changeSetApproveInputV3.x-proof-success-binding: For operation changeset.approve/v3, the success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is required-uuidv7 and application_key equals input.idempotency_key; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact ChangeSetApprovalV1 result); application_effect_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:remote-authority-record:v1 over RFC 8785(that exact decoded authority payload); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

delegationIssueInputV2.description: Complete caller-selected material needed to reconstruct the direct DelegationV2 payload after the server injects the locked Workspace, issuing Human, authority sequence/predecessor/key and recorded issue time. operating_principal_id maps exactly to recipient_principal_id; actions, scope, constraints, not_before and expires_at are copied without reinterpretation. The resource-intent pair and idempotency key bind authorization and retry evidence but are not silently added to the accepted DelegationV2 bytes.
delegationIssueInputV2.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For delegation.issue/v2 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {delegation_id,operating_principal_id,resource_intent_id,resource_intent_digest,actions,scope,constraints,not_before,expires_at,idempotency_key} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:delegation.issue,version:proof.dev/operation/delegation.issue/v2}}; private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
delegationIssueInputV2.x-proof-set-order: actions, scope.environment_ids, scope.object_ids, scope.schema_ids and scope.locales are already sorted by their accepted canonical byte order and contain no duplicates; the server rejects rather than silently reorders caller bytes
delegationIssueInputV2.x-proof-success-cross-check: Result delegation_id equals input.delegation_id; recipient_principal_id equals input.operating_principal_id; actions, scope, constraints, not_before and expires_at equal input byte-for-byte; delegation_profile is proof.local/authority/direct/v1. Result workspace_id and issuer_principal_id equal the authenticated command Workspace and requesting Human; issued_at is generated once and retry-stable. Result authority_sequence == locked evaluated authority-head sequence + 1 without overflow and previous_authority_record_digest equals that head's record digest. The server loads ContentResourceIntentV1 by input.resource_intent_id, requires its proof:content-resource-intent:v1 digest to equal input.resource_intent_digest, its Workspace/issuer to equal this command, and its exact environment/Object/Schema/locale targets to cover the requested Delegation scope. The recipient Agent is enabled, not_before < expires_at, expiry and budgets remain within policy. Resource-intent fields and idempotency_key bind the decision/replay but are never injected into DelegationV2 bytes.
delegationIssueInputV2.x-proof-success-binding: For operation delegation.issue/v2, the success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is required-uuidv7 and application_key equals input.idempotency_key; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact DelegationV2 result); application_effect_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:remote-authority-record:v1 over RFC 8785(that exact decoded authority payload); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

delegationRevokeInputV1.description: Exact append-only revocation request for one current DelegationV2; it never edits or reinterprets the Delegation.
delegationRevokeInputV1.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For delegation.revoke/v1 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {delegation_id,reason,idempotency_key} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:delegation.revoke,version:proof.dev/operation/delegation.revoke/v1}}; private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
delegationRevokeInputV1.x-proof-success-cross-check: The server locks the exact existing, unrevoked DelegationV2 named by input.delegation_id and verifies the requesting Human is its issuer or an active authority.admin under the locked head. Result delegation_id and reason equal input byte-for-byte; workspace_id equals the authenticated command Workspace; revoked_by_principal_id is the authenticated requesting Human; revocation_id and revoked_at are generated once and retry-stable. Result authority_sequence == locked evaluated authority-head sequence + 1 without overflow and previous_authority_record_digest equals that head's record digest.
delegationRevokeInputV1.x-proof-success-binding: For operation delegation.revoke/v1, the success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is required-uuidv7 and application_key equals input.idempotency_key; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact DelegationRevocationV1 result); application_effect_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:remote-authority-record:v1 over RFC 8785(that exact decoded authority payload); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

deliveryGetInputV1.description: Exact no-key read of one delivery generation; a stale generation is a conflict and never aliases newer state.
deliveryGetInputV1.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For delivery.get/v1 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {event_id,delivery_id,expected_generation} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:delivery.get,version:proof.dev/operation/delivery.get/v1}}; private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
deliveryGetInputV1.x-proof-success-binding: For operation delivery.get/v1, the success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is none, application_key is null and application_effect_digest is null; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact DeliveryGetResultV1); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

deliveryGetResultV1.description: Exact projection of the delivery row selected by deliveryGetInputV1 at the committed transaction snapshot.
deliveryGetResultV1.x-proof-request-state-cross-check: event_id and delivery_id equal the normalized input and selected immutable event/delivery identities; generation equals both input.expected_generation and the current delivery generation. status, attempts_in_generation and next_attempt_at equal that same current state. receipt_digest is null exactly when the current state has no receipt; otherwise it equals the documented digest of the exact immutable receipt fact selected by the state's receipt identity. A stale expected_generation fails with proof.state.conflict and never returns a newer generation under the stale request.
deliveryGetResultV1.x-proof-result-digest-rule: BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(this exact result value).

attempts_in_generation.description: Claims consumed in the current delivery generation; immutable attempts from earlier generations remain in history.

deliveryReplayInputV1.description: Exact keyed replay of one locked dead-letter generation; expected_generation is capped so the required successor generation is representable without overflow.
deliveryReplayInputV1.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For delivery.replay/v1 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {event_id,delivery_id,expected_generation,idempotency_key} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:delivery.replay,version:proof.dev/operation/delivery.replay/v1}}; private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
deliveryReplayInputV1.x-proof-success-binding: For operation delivery.replay/v1, event_id, delivery_id and expected_generation select the exact locked dead-letter generation; the result and committed state satisfy #/$defs/deliveryReplayResultV1 and #/$defs/deliveryManagementFactV1. The success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is required-uuidv7 and application_key equals input.idempotency_key; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact deliveryReplayResultV1 result); application_effect_digest is the result management_fact_digest and is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:delivery-management-fact:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact deliveryManagementFactV1); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

deliveryAbandonInputV1.description: Exact keyed abandonment of one locked dead-letter generation; reason is copied into the immutable management fact.
deliveryAbandonInputV1.x-proof-byte-limits: UTF-8 byte_length(reason) is 1..=256. JSON Schema maxLength is only an early code-point bound; multibyte overflow is rejected.
deliveryAbandonInputV1.x-proof-public-input-projection-rule: For delivery.abandon/v1 the exact disclosure-safe public projection is {event_id,delivery_id,expected_generation,reason,idempotency_key} copied byte-for-byte from this closed input. public_input_projection_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:public-operation-input-projection:v1 over RFC 8785 of {api_version:proof.dev/public-operation-input-projection/v1,input:<that exact projection>,operation:{name:delivery.abandon,version:proof.dev/operation/delivery.abandon/v1}}; private actor/session material and the private exact-input digest are excluded.
deliveryAbandonInputV1.x-proof-success-binding: For operation delivery.abandon/v1, event_id, delivery_id and expected_generation select the exact locked dead-letter generation and reason is copied byte-for-byte; the result and committed state satisfy #/$defs/deliveryAbandonResultV1 and #/$defs/deliveryManagementFactV1. The success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 application_key_kind is required-uuidv7 and application_key equals input.idempotency_key; result_digest is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact deliveryAbandonResultV1 result); application_effect_digest is the result management_fact_digest and is BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:delivery-management-fact:v1 over RFC 8785(the exact deliveryManagementFactV1); prior_result_digest and problem_code are null.

deliveryManagementFactV1.description: Immutable application fact for an authorized replay or abandonment. It is not a RemoteAuthorityRecordV1 payload; the signed RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 for the operation binds this fact's digest as application_effect_digest.
deliveryManagementFactV1.x-proof-operation-cross-check: For replay, event_id, delivery_id, from_generation and idempotency_key equal deliveryReplayInputV1, reason is exactly dead-letter-replay, and to_generation == from_generation + 1 without integer overflow. For abandonment, those fields equal deliveryAbandonInputV1, reason equals the exact normalized input reason byte-for-byte, and to_generation is null. workspace_id, actor_context_evidence_digest, recorded_at and workspace_transaction_sequence come from the same authorized committed application transaction; no worker-side or unsigned state mutation may synthesize this fact.

reason.description: Authoritative operator reason committed in the immutable management fact. For abandonment it equals the exact normalized request reason; for replay it is the server's stable normalized replay reason derived under the operation contract.

deliveryReplayResultV1.description: Exact committed replay result. Its management fact is the governed immutable application effect; the separately signed RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 binds both digests.
deliveryReplayResultV1.x-proof-result-digest-rule: BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(this exact result value).
deliveryReplayResultV1.x-proof-success-cross-check: event_id, delivery_id and from_generation equal deliveryReplayInputV1 and the locked current dead-letter state; to_generation == from_generation + 1 without overflow. The committed delivery state has those identities, generation == to_generation, status pending, attempts_in_generation 0 and no lease or receipt; its generation start/next-attempt schedule is installed in the same transaction. management_fact_digest == BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:delivery-management-fact:v1 over RFC 8785(application fact), whose replay fields equal the input/result. The success RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 has the exact replay operation, application_key_kind required-uuidv7, application_key equal to input.idempotency_key, result_digest == BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(this exact result value), application_effect_digest == management_fact_digest and problem_code/prior_result_digest null.

deliveryAbandonResultV1.description: Exact committed abandonment result. Its management fact is the governed immutable application effect; the separately signed RemoteApplicationConsequenceV1 binds both digests.

objectQueryReleasedResultV1.x-proof-query-cross-check: workspace_id equals the authenticated command Workspace; environment_id, principal_id and delegation_id equal normalized_input.environment_id, normalized_input.operating_principal_id and normalized_input.delegation_id and the repeated command actor fields. release_id and edition_id name the exact current immutable released source selected at the transaction snapshot. objects is non-empty, its object_id values are unique and canonically ordered, and objects[*].object_id has the same length and is elementwise equal to the complete canonically normalized input.object_ids (an empty request is never a wildcard, no requested Object may be omitted and no unrequested Object may appear). Every Object equals the exact active revision referenced by that Edition and passes releasedObjectV1 canonical-content and proof:object-revision:v1 digest reproduction. authorization_decision_digest is the exact decision for the command actor, Delegation, requested action, environment, complete requested Object set, evaluation time and authority head; it is not a generic allow token.
objectQueryReleasedResultV1.x-proof-result-digest-rule: BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(this exact result value).

workspaceStatusInputV1.description: Exact empty signed normalized_input subject for retained workspace.status/v1. Actor and Delegation identities exist only in the surrounding authenticated command and are not injected into this normalized application value.

workspaceStatusResultV1.description: Exact result-data subject advertised by the accepted workspace.status/v1 CAPABILITY_REGISTRY output Schema. The transport result envelope is outside this application value.
workspaceStatusResultV1.x-proof-status-cross-check: workspace_id, requesting_principal_id, operating_principal_id and delegation_id equal the authenticated command Workspace/requesting/operating/Delegation identities. The empty normalized input contributes no hidden selector. authorization_decision_digest reproduces the exact workspace.status/v1 decision for requested action workspace:status, these actors, the evaluated Delegation, evaluation time and authority head. storage_schema_version, authoritative_sequence and state_digest are read from one verified current committed snapshot at that same head; state_digest is the established proof:known-state:v1 digest for workspace_id and authoritative_sequence, not a cached or caller-supplied value.
workspaceStatusResultV1.x-proof-result-digest-rule: BLAKE3-256 derive-key proof:operation-effect:v1 over RFC 8785(this exact result value).

sessionGetResultV1.description: Same-origin private no-store session projection. csrf_token is an independent uniformly random 256-bit base64url synchronizer, stored server-side only as a digest, bound to this session, and rotated with login or reauthentication.

evidenceExportMemberKindV2.description: Closed ready-export byte-address kind. The two reserved values address bundle.json and manifest.json; root and nested kinds reuse the verifier-owned RemoteEvidenceV2 registries.

evidenceArtifactGetInputV2.description: Exact ready-export producer-byte selector. It resolves only a reserved descriptor/manifest member, a captured root whose delivery is included, or a unique nested artifact declared Included by the captured release closure. An external-required root is never producer-addressable even when its kind and digest are known.
evidenceArtifactGetInputV2.x-proof-selection-rule: Resolve the exact (export_id, artifact_kind, artifact_digest) triple against the immutable ready graph. Eligibility is exactly one of: the reserved bundle descriptor pair, the reserved manifest pair, one manifest root descriptor with delivery=included, or one unique Included nested ArtifactRef in the release closure. Unknown, cross-kind same-digest, duplicate, external-required, or otherwise unlisted selectors do not resolve.

evidenceArtifactMetadataV2.description: Metadata and response-header projection for the exact ready export member selected by the request path. The response body remains opaque exact bytes.
evidenceArtifactMetadataV2.x-proof-path-cross-check: export_id, artifact_kind, and artifact_digest equal the request/path values byte-for-byte. Selection is the exact kind-and-digest pair; a digest under another kind/context is not an alias.
evidenceArtifactMetadataV2.x-proof-byte-cross-check: artifact_kind, artifact_media_type and byte_length equal the captured membership/catalog metadata for the returned exact bytes. remote_evidence_bundle_v2 uses proof:remote-evidence-bundle:v2 over exact canonical bundle.json; remote_evidence_manifest_v2 uses proof:remote-evidence-manifest:v2 over exact canonical manifest.json; every root/nested kind uses its frozen verifier mapping. Recomputed BLAKE3 equals artifact_digest.
evidenceArtifactMetadataV2.x-proof-header-cross-check: Content-Type is application/octet-stream; Content-Length equals byte_length; Content-Digest is lowercase algorithm token blake3 followed by the canonical Base64 Structured Fields byte sequence for the same raw 32 digest bytes; ETag is exactly the quoted artifact_digest with no weak prefix; X-Proof-Artifact-Digest equals artifact_digest; and X-Proof-Artifact-Kind equals artifact_kind. No content encoding or alternate digest representation is permitted.

previewObjectGetResultV1.description: Private exact-Release preview projection. Repeated selectors are integrity cross-checks, not independently selectable aliases.
previewObjectGetResultV1.x-proof-request-cross-check: environment_id, release_id, object_id and locale equal the normalized request/path values byte-for-byte
previewObjectGetResultV1.x-proof-rendition-cross-check: object_id == rendition.object_id; locale == rendition.locale; rendition_digest == rendition.rendition_digest; release/edition identities and digests equal the verified manifest members used to load rendition
previewObjectGetResultV1.x-proof-etag-cross-check: etag is exactly one double quote, the rendition_digest bytes, and one double quote (no weak prefix); cache_control is emitted exactly as declared
